summary: Module 10 FIX: Detected and resolved a deployment misconfiguration in railway.json where healthcheckPath was pointed to the liveness endpoint (/health) instead of the readiness endpoint (/ready), along with a high timeout value (100s). Re-pointing to /ready guarantees the orchestrator only sends traffic once Postgres and Redis are fully reachable.
evidence: Modified railway.json to set healthcheckPath to /ready and healthcheckTimeout to 5.
Verified local container startup and health/readiness endpoints respond correctly under normal and simulated failure conditions.
Confirmed graceful shutdown behavior upon container termination.
